name: psoares-teleprompter
description: Script writing for videos and the Markdown Teleprompter app. Includes storytelling for the structure that keeps people watching (stakes, a big question, head fakes, re-hooks), video-script for lesson and demo scripts written one take per line, and teleprompter-script for writing and editing video and presentation scripts in the app's Markdown syntax: directives, presenter tabs, presenter notes, voice cues and spoken-delivery style.
